name: skill-router
description: A meta-skill that installs and maintains a deterministic two-stage skill router (discovery, routing, command resolution) in an agent repository. Use when the user wants to set up the routing environment, synchronize the registry after skills change, route a request to the right skill and command, or benchmark routing quality.
capabilities: synchronize the skill registry and routing manifest
route requests with three decisions route ambiguous no_route
detect corpus to routing manifest drift
use_when: route a request to the right skill

route_request: route a request to the right skill

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Establish the routing environment: create skills/ and the registry, generate candidate manifests for skills that lack one, install skill.py, append the agent.md contract. Idempotent and conservative.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Idempotent synchronization: rebuild registry.json + routing-manifest.json from manifests, validate everything, report orphans.

commands.name: discover
commands.description: Rebuild skill-registry/registry.json and routing-manifest.json from skill manifests.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Print the skill index: every routable skill and its commands.

commands.name: route
commands.description: Route a user request to the best skill or minimal multi-skill plan; returns route/ambiguous/no_route with minimal output; --debug shows the score breakdown.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate all manifests, registry, and corpus-to-routing-manifest drift; exit 0/1.

commands.name: benchmark
commands.description: Run the gold-set benchmark in-process and report decision accuracy.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose router files, generated metadata, and manifest drift without changing the filesystem.
